title: Membership Tenure Discount on Operating Lines of Credit
content:
Long-standing members of the cooperative earn a membership discount on the contract rate of the Operating Lines of Credit set on the AutoDraft enrolment day. Membership is shown by the member's borrower stock in Member Equities & Patronage.

## Rule

- A membership discount of **0.05 points** applies when the member's voting stock or participation certificate in active status was issued 120 or more whole months before the enrolment day.
- A membership discount of **0.025 points** applies when it was issued at least 60 but fewer than 120 whole months before.
- **No** membership discount applies when it was issued more recently or the member holds none.

The voting stock is Class B Voting Stock and the participation certificate is the Class C Participation Certificate; the issue date and status are read from the member's Member Equities & Patronage records. The membership discount is one of the rate discounts that are added together and capped at the product's discount cap.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical enrolment on 1 June)

| Borrower stock in active status | Issued | Whole months before the enrolment day | Membership discount (points) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Class B Voting Stock | 1 June, ten years earlier | 120 | 0.05 |
| Class B Voting Stock | 2 June, ten years earlier | 119 | 0.025 |
| Class C Participation Certificate | 1 June, five years earlier | 60 | 0.025 |
| Class C Participation Certificate | 2 June, five years earlier | 59 | None |
| Class A Nonvoting Common Stock only | Any date | — | None — neither voting stock nor a participation certificate |
